name: FAI_SAM_RAW_PROCESSOUT
description: This table stores processout records for sam ai consumption

columns.name: RAW_PROCESSOUT_ID
columns.description: Primary Key of the process out data

columns.name: CONTEXT
columns.description: Context in which process out data were executed

columns.name: KEY
columns.description: Unique key of the process out data

columns.name: VALUE
columns.description: Value of the process out data for a key

columns.name: DATE_DATA
columns.description: Date on which this record was executed

columns.name: COLLECTION_TIME
columns.description: Time of the collection of the process out

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the executed record in processout

columns.name: CONSUMER_DATA_KEY
columns.description: Reference Key on the consumer side

columns.name: ANOMALY_LOOP
columns.description: Loop back on accuracy of the anomaly

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: RAW_LOAD_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to the fai_sam_raw_load table
